ED Raids Karnataka Minister Satish Jarkiholi and Daughter's Premises

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) conducted searches at 18 locations across Karnataka, including the Bengaluru residence of Karnataka Public Works Department Minister Satish Jarkiholi and his daughter, Member of Parliament Priyanka Jarkiholi. The raids are reportedly linked to a money laundering case. One report specified the investigation concerns an alleged Rs 178-crore excise scam, separate from a new money laundering case against the minister involving his brother-in-law Manjunath.
